review_comments.body: @KiaraGrouwstra Do you know how you could do this in finix?

i can't actually find such a [manual](https://github.com/search?q=repo%3Afinix-community%2Ffinix%20manual&type=code) on their end (/cc @aanderse) so i think they would not even need funny workarounds like this second commit here

looks like we [can](https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/compare/master...KiaraGrouwstra:nixpkgs:lib-services-import) do better tho keeping e.g. the manual build working involves moving the used modules to `lib/` - i can add that here if desired / if #545732 lands.

I think we should make it overridable, but perhaps not change the default?
Telling `lib` about `lib/` seems a bit redundant, and the change could break existing callers.

```suggestion
      baseModules ? [ ./service.nix ],
```
thanks for notifying i'd forgotten about this @eveeifyeve, i addressed it now
